## Discovery-only current-work worksheet — blank

PA-I15 / A01-PA2; P01/P08; N03/N08/N09; W01/W23/W25. Use before app-assisted evaluation when specimens, operators or fit evidence are unavailable. Preparation permits no outreach; contact and voluntary participation need their applicable authority. Do not request private order images, customer details or credentials. Product demonstrations and promises must not prime the initial account of existing work. All answers below are **Not collected**.

| Neutral prompt / record | How to interpret and follow up |
|---|---|
| What responsibility do you hold, and which parts of checking do you personally perform? | Record actual duty and context; a buyer cannot establish every operator's experience. Identify missing perspectives and conflicts |
| Walk through the last relevant packing/checking task, from receiving work to closing or handing it over | Record inputs, steps, decisions, artifacts, interruptions, exceptions and accepting next person; distinguish a recalled report from direct observation |
| When did the current method work well, and when was it inadequate? | Preserve positive evidence for the existing method and negative evidence for the proposed product; ask for concrete examples without unnecessary personal data |
| What happens when contents are unclear, help is absent or the workstation fails? | Record the actual manual fallback, stopping authority, waiting and responsibility transfer; do not imply ProofPack already resolves the gap |
| Which visible properties matter, and which need a different inspection method? | Record unsupported/hidden-property exclusions and how correctness would be independently established; no physical accuracy claim from descriptions |
| What setup, training, repeated effort and support can this business reasonably sustain? | Keep reported tolerances separate from measured time/cost. Ask task-relevant language/access preferences voluntarily; no diagnoses or employee ranking |
| Who decides about budget, workplace/data conditions, support and ending use? | Identify accepting duties, applicable approvers, data restrictions, exit needs and unavailable owners; AWS access does not approve deployment |
| What would make you keep the existing method, defer evaluation or decline this product? | Record disconfirming conditions and strongest alternative before discussing proposed features; no required positive reaction or purchase commitment |

For each material answer, record a stable finding ID, date, minimized source reference, context, classification (SELF_REPORTED unless directly observed), limits/conflicts and next validation action. Missing answers remain UNKNOWN. Separately label any subsequent concept discussion as HYPOTHESIS; no invented quotations. Close with permission/retention handling, unresolved perspectives and an accountable next action: investigate, prepare a permitted comparison, defer or decline. Interviews cannot pass physical task, human app-comprehension or beta gates. A01-PA2 remains NOT_RUN until actual authorized execution.

Ask the following prompts before coaching. Record the participant's explanation, exact artifact/state being discussed, permitted notes and any assistance. Use PASS when the participant explains the required boundary unaided, FAIL when they materially misunderstand it, BLOCKED when the task cannot be assessed, and NOT_RUN when it was not asked. A taught answer is an assisted retest with a new attempt ID, not an unassisted PASS. These are proposed comprehension criteria; no person has been assessed.

| Prompt / applicable scenarios | Required understanding | Result / permitted observation / assessor |
|---|---|---|
| What did this check, and what still needs checking? A02 A03 A08 | Only configured visible contents were assessed; hidden properties and the complete manual check remain outside the automated result | NOT_RUN |
| What does this result mean after the scene changes or capture stops? A03 A04 | A historical image/decision is not current approval; obtain a fresh observation or stop and use manual checking | NOT_RUN |
| What happens if the correction cannot be completed or nobody answers for help? A04 A06 | Stop relying on the result, preserve unresolved context and use the agreed manual process; do not reset budgets or continue unsupervised | NOT_RUN |
| Who can approve a configuration or authorize consequential action? A05 A06 | Explicit current owner authority governs configuration; an app observation never authorizes shipment; reviewer/developer titles confer no extra role | NOT_RUN |
| What do these data choices and cleanup receipts actually cover? A07 | Required processing and optional reuse differ; selected-object cleanup does not certify metadata, backups or downloaded-copy erasure; know the verified request route | NOT_RUN |
| What does this dataset receipt establish, and what happens when its permission expires? A05 A07 | A locally prepared diagnostic manifest does not establish independent truth or an untouched holdout. Image and associated review-data reuse require separate explicit scope. Expiry or withdrawal holds use; an old page or access event cannot restore it | NOT_RUN |
| What changes if you retire the manifest or declassify a group? A05 A07 | Retirement ends that manifest's use but preserves group assignments. Owner declassification moves the group to development, changes DATA and invalidates dependent manifests; it cannot create independent benchmark eligibility | NOT_RUN |
| What would make you choose another method or decline repeat use? A01 A08 A09 | Can state limits, alternatives and their own decision without being required to endorse ProofPack | NOT_RUN |

At close, record P01–P09 as assessed, missing, or not applicable with a reason, with links to the applicable A scenarios and actual attempts. One multi-role participant does not establish independent review or represent every persona. Missing downstream recipients, supplier contributors and applicable approvers remain discovery limitations. Record keyboard/zoom/language or other requested adjustments and actual completion separately; browser automation does not establish human accessibility.

For a stopped handoff record: unresolved kit/inspection ID, last valid observation or unknown, reason, originating actor, intended recipient, acknowledgment/time or unavailable status, safe manual action, data permissions, and who may resume. An unanswered message is not an accepted transfer. No available supervisor ends the supervised attempt. If an incorrect/stale approval, unauthorized capture or uncontrolled cost occurs, preserve the failure, stop the session and require the applicable incident/recovery authorization before retest.
